"""Run after the environment confirms that synthetic account credits are restored."""
import json,time
from api import call
from pathlib import Path
body=json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name('run-request.json').read_text())
receipt=call('POST','/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs',body,'launch-resumed')
print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
if receipt['status']!=202:raise SystemExit(1)
rid=receipt['body']['runId']
for i in range(12):
 result=call('GET','/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/'+rid,label='run-status')
 print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
 if result['body'].get('status') in ['completed','failed','cancelled','error']:break
 time.sleep(2)
for suffix,label in [('iterations','iterations'),('decision-summary','decision-summary')]:
 print(json.dumps(call('GET','/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/'+rid+'/'+suffix,label=label),indent=2))
PY
